fields.subject: OrleansExpressionHelper
fields.trigger: the helper compiles the grain-id-from-model delegate for a model type
fields.response: compile a delegate that, for each of the model's record-identifier-marked properties in their declared order, appends the property's value into one byte buffer via SpanParser.Append and wraps the written bytes in an IdSpan
fields.postcondition: the returned IdSpan's length equals the sum of each appended value's encoded length plus one delimiter byte for every property after the first
